inShort: For two-handed backhands: A and B volley backhand to backhand and switch to one hand only when the ball comes too close to the body or too wide.
rules: A and B stand diagonally at the kitchen line and volley cross-court, backhand to backhand.
Start every ball from the two-handed ready position.
Ball within reach: two-handed backhand volley.
Ball close to the body or too far out: let go with the off hand and volley one-handed.
Slow and cooperative at first. Find out where your own limit lies.
tooEasy: Aim at the other's body on purpose; a point for every ball that forces a one-handed answer.
tooHard: A feeds slow single balls to B's backhand, some at the body, some wide. B volleys each one back, two hands or one, and A starts the next ball. No rally.
goodLooksLike: The switch to one hand comes early, and both kinds of volley stay low over the net.
